brand.name: Physio Goals
brand.description: Evidence-based physiotherapy focused on your recovery. Whether you're bouncing back from injury, managing chronic pain, or pushing your athletic performance, we put your goals at the centre of every session.

hero.headline: Move better. Live better.
hero.subhead: Goal-oriented physiotherapy that gets you back to doing what you love.

items.title: Your goals drive your care
items.body: We don't believe in one-size-fits-all treatment. Every plan is built around what matters to you — whether that's running again, returning to work, or simply moving without pain.

items.title: Hands-on treatment, real results
items.body: Our evidence-based approach combines hands-on therapy with targeted exercise prescription. You'll understand exactly what we're doing and why.

items.title: Progress you can feel
items.body: We track your movement, strength, and function every step of the way. You'll see tangible improvements, not just promises.

items.title: Your recovery, your way
items.body: From in-clinic sessions to telehealth consultations, we work around your schedule and preferences. You're in control of how we work together.

items.title: Injury rehabilitation
items.body: From acute injuries to niggling strains, we'll get you moving again safely and stronger than before.

items.title: Sports physiotherapy
items.body: Whether you're elite or keen, we help athletes prevent injury and perform at their best.

items.title: Chronic pain management
items.body: Long-term pain needs a different approach. We'll help you build resilience and reclaim your life.

items.title: Post-surgical rehabilitation
items.body: Following surgery? We'll guide you through each stage of recovery with expert, hands-on care.

items.title: Exercise prescription
items.body: The right exercises, done the right way. We'll teach you a program you can own.

items.title: Movement assessment
items.body: We'll identify what's holding you back and create a clear plan to get you moving better.

sections.title: Why work with us
sections.body: Physio Goals isn't about ticking boxes. We're here to help you reach your goals — whether that's getting back on the football field, returning to the garden, or simply waking up without pain. We combine clinical expertise with genuine care, giving you the hands-on treatment and education you need to take control of your recovery. Progress you can actually feel. That's the difference.

items.title: Back to running
items.body: After my knee injury, I wasn't sure I'd ever run again. The team at Physio Goals got me moving in a way that felt safe and purposeful. Six months later, I'm back to my 5K routine.

items.title: Finally understood my pain
items.body: I've seen physios before, but this team actually explained what was going on and why the exercises mattered. I felt like a partner in my own recovery.

items.title: Telehealth made it work
items.body: Living rurally, consistency was always tough. Being able to do sessions online kept me on track without the drive. Best decision for my rehab.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: Ready to reach your goals? Get in contact with us to book your first session and start your recovery journey.

footer.blurb: Physio Goals — evidence-based physiotherapy built around your recovery. Your goals, our expertise.
